title: High-Resolution Image Synthesis with Latent Diffusion Models
blurb: Moved diffusion into the latent space of a pretrained autoencoder and conditioned it through cross-attention, the recipe behind Stable Diffusion.
intro: A perceptual autoencoder compresses images to a small latent grid once, and the diffusion model only ever sees latents, which cuts training and sampling cost sharply. Text or other conditions enter the denoiser through cross-attention, with latent positions as queries and condition tokens as keys and values. The steps build the autoencoders, attention over latent positions, cross-attention in a decoder block, classifier-free guidance and the DDIM update; the capstone wires them into a guided sampler that decodes its final latent.

steps.name: VAE-regularised latents
steps.note: The paper's KL-regularised autoencoder keeps latents close to a standard normal.

steps.name: Cross-attention inside a block
steps.note: The same query-from-one-sequence, keys-from-another pattern conditions the denoiser on text.
